0022600218.text: The Cavaliers arrive at 5-6 overall, 1-4 on the road, and 7th in the East after losing their last two games, while the Knicks come in 6-4 on a four-game winning streak and 4th in the East. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), and New York is missing Josh Hart (illness). The teams have met once this season, a 109-97 Knicks win in Cleveland on November 7, and the Cavaliers lost 1-2 to New York in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
